Flow.description: SFP-5728 Case automation related to when a case is in a isClosed state. This would cover both Resolved as well as Closed SFP-26085 - Added filter to prevent resolution emails for child hand-off cases (cases with origin "hand-off" SFP-27710 - Queries Management. When the case is created using a 'Global team', we have it stamped in Service team. But the Global Team does not have all information needed for all the automation processes(email templates, email address, etc.). So if the team that the case was created under, e.g. Global Team, is different from the actual team of a team it was routed to we are to use the case owner's team to extract all the information for automation purposes. SFP-42067 - Bug fix Resolving / Closing of Child Hand Off Cases SFP-36195 Complaint Outcome Auto Response SFP-43644 - Change record type for Unresolved cases SFP-44365 - PPB SA-Closure/Rating email to be switched off for the specific Outcomes SFP-44420 - PPB SA Complaints: Notification to banker SFP-44064 - Send Insurance NPS Surveys via Marketing Cloud. SFP-35988 - SA Complaints Management | SMS functionality SFP-42025 - Help A Client: Staff member feedback SFP-31300 - Rejected Complaints Outcome PDF Letter SFP-51072 - Added the Stop Survey Functionality for SBO PPBSF-40 - Suppress Resolution Autoresponses being sent for non-email Cases if SVC_SuppressCaseResolutionEmails is enabled in Team settings SFP-49565 - Include Private Heads on Classification and Resolution Notifications SFP-56297 - Adding the NPS SBG Domain Exclusion Setting for input.
Flow.label: SVC Case Defaults - Set isClosed
